texts.zh: 随着[Root.GetName]上的犯罪率不断下降，当地政府得以集中精力对付[office_owner.GetName]在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上的非法企业。大批人员被逮捕，迫使该犯罪集团的分部被关闭。
texts.en: As crime levels continue to drop on [Root.GetName], the local authorities have been able to focus their efforts on thwarting the illegal enterprises operated by the [office_owner.GetName] on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. A large number of arrests have been made, forcing their criminal branch office out of business.

texts.zh: 由于当地政府最近进行的大量逮捕行动，我们设立于[From.Owner.GetName]境内的[From.GetName]上的分部最近被迫关闭。似乎是因为[From.GetPlanetMoon]上的犯罪度下降，使其执法部门得以集中警力阻碍我们的活动。
texts.en: Our branch office on [From.GetName] inside the [From.Owner.GetName] was recently forced to close after mass arrests made by the local authorities. It seems that the recent reduction in crime on the [From.GetPlanetMoon] enabled their law enforcement agencies to focus their efforts on disrupting our operations.
